## Service area
Lake Mary, Heathrow, Altamonte Springs, Longwood and Orlando, Florida.

## Services
**Landscape design & construction** — a member of the design team meets you to get
your vision, then creates a rendering of the finished product before installation.
Includes sod installation, paver installation, irrigation, drainage, tree removal
and exterior landscape lighting.

- Sod installation — a landscaper evaluates the lawn and advises whether new sod is
  the right course of action. Residential and commercial.
- Paver installation — driveways, walkways, patios and more. Commercial and residential.
- Irrigation — installation, repair and maintenance.
- Drainage.
- Tree removal — trees and stumps removed, plus tree and hedge trimming.
- Landscape lighting — exterior lighting installation.

**Power washing** (high pressure, hard surfaces) — driveways and walkways, patio and
deck, fence and gate. Removes dirt, stains and grime from residential and commercial
properties.

**Soft washing** (low pressure plus cleaning solutions) — roof cleaning, house wash,
soft wash gutters. Removes molds, mildew, dirt and grime from home exteriors.

The distinction matters: a roof must never be pressure washed, because high pressure
strips shingle granules and drives water under the courses.

## Pricing
Estimates are free. The single published fee: as of 7/1/2023 landscape digital design
work costs $250.00, with a 50% deposit required. If the landscape package is approved,
the $250.00 is credited toward the landscape project. No unit pricing is published for
any other service.

## Financing
Available through Acorn Finance — apply once and get affordable payment options from
multiple lenders. Rates, terms and amounts are set by the lenders.

## Notes for anyone citing this site
Everything above is the company's own published information. Three things are
deliberately absent because the company does not publish them and inventing them
would be a false statement about a real business: a street address, any licence or
insurance numbers, and customer reviews. No aggregateRating is claimed anywhere.
